Far Cry 5 Is The Most Disappointing Game In The Series

In Far Cry 5, the player character is a silent protagonist who fights against a cult. You play the game as a member of the local resistance, but your avatar is silent. You will rarely have a personality. In-game, you will only know that you have to defeat the cult.

My thought process was the same.

We fight a common enemy and talk about what he did to us.

When I first started to hear reports of Far Cry 5's narrative choices, I thought it was just uninformed opinion. The trailer didn't do much to connect me to the characters or plot. Since it was an open world game, I expected not to care as much about the details. Even if the character I played as was not very talkative, I thought I would still be interested in what they had to say.

I was wrong.

Far Cry 5 Is The Most Disappointing Game In The Series

There are no relatable characters in Far Cry 5. The leaders of Eden's Gate want to build a private utopia in Montana, and the rest of the world makes them the target of their vitriol. The game's plot is focused on the resistance's quest to oust Joseph Seed and his family. The Seeds are always a step ahead and the tone of the game vacillates between deadly seriousness and utter abysmal goofiness, leaving both narrative strings frayed and dangling.

The player is supposed to care about all of this, and they are supposed to care about Pew Pew, who is a deadly shooter, and who has a close bond with a guy running a fireworks show, but the main characters never elevate the story to something meaningful. 当然可以！我们来逐句翻译并解释这些词汇：

### 1. 这行话原文

> erect, eclectic, resentment, guise, and jurisdiction.

### 2. 逐词解析

- **erect**  
  中文里最常见的是“建立”，“修建”，“抬头直立”等意思。在文学里常指“站立安然”或者形容建筑物。

- **eclectic**  
  中文意为“抄fficMix和”，“琐碎的，擅长汲取他人长处的”。“eclectic”来自拉丁文“eclecticus”，指从不同地方搜集而来的。形容某人或东西风格多样、取长补短。

- **resentment**  
  意为“怨恨”、“不满”、“委屈”。比如对于被冤枉或者对待不公平的心理。

- **guise**  
  “外褙”、“伪装”、“伪装成……的模样”。比如“in human guise”就是“以人的外表/伪装”。

- **jurisdiction**

As far as I am concerned, advertisements do more harm than good.

Firstly, advertisements can create a lot of pressure on people, especially teenagers and young adults. They often present an idealized life and make people feel that they are not good enough unless they buy certain products. For example, beauty advertisements always show perfect models and encourage people to buy expensive skincare products, which may not be necessary or affordable for everyone. This can make people insecure.

Secondly, there are too many advertisements nowadays. Whether we are watching TV, using the internet, or even walking in the street, we see all kinds of advertisements. This can be very annoying and sometimes even interrupts our daily activities or work. Some people even feel tired or headaches because of the constant exposure to advertisements.

Thirdly, advertisements sometimes use lies or exaggerate the benefits of their products. Some advertisements claim that a certain item is the best or the healthiest, but in reality, this is not always true. People might be misled and spend their money on products that are not really good, which is a waste of money.

Besides the above reasons, there is one more important point I’d like to mention: advertisements can also hurt our environment. Many companies use a lot of paper, plastic, and other materials for printing and displaying ads, which increases pollution. Some advertisements even promote wasteful lifestyles, making people buy things they do not really need.

In conclusion, although advertisements help businesses sell their products, they have more disadvantages than advantages for individuals and society. Therefore, it is important to be careful when watching or reading advertisements and to develop our own judgment.
